name: Homosexaulity
overview: Scripture clearly defines homosexuality as contrary to God's design, describing same-sex relations as an abomination (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). From creation, God established the distinct roles of male and female (Mark 10:6), and deviations from this order, including cross-dressing, are also condemned (Deuteronomy 22:5). While God acknowledges eunuchs who faithfully observe His covenant (Isaiah 56:4), the biblical witness calls all to uphold His standards, warning that human wisdom apart from God leads to folly (Romans 1:22).
